two_factor.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
two_factor.codes_help: If you lose your phone, each of these signs you in once instead of a code from the app. They are shown only now. Keep them somewhere safe, apart from your phone.
two_factor.prove: To {{action}}, enter your password and a code from your app (or a recovery code).
two_factor.start_failed: Could not start the set-up. Try again.
two_factor.code_wrong: That code is not right. Check the app and try again.
two_factor.title: Two-factor sign-in
two_factor.intro: Besides your password, signing in asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, 1Password...).
two_factor.load_failed: Could not load the state of two-factor sign-in. Reload the page to try again.
two_factor.required: Your company requires it for everyone, so it cannot be turned off.
two_factor.step_scan: Open your authenticator app and add an account by scanning this code.
two_factor.step_code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows for FixFlow.
two_factor.cannot_scan: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app instead:
two_factor.action_new_codes: get new recovery codes (the old ones stop working)
